Reporting & Insights

• Build weekly and monthly client reports with clear, executive-ready insights

• Analyze campaign performance trends and identify optimization opportunities

• Combine data from multiple sources into actionable recommendations

• Maintain dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reporting processes

• Translate performance data into clear stories for internal and client audiences

Strategy & Execution

• Launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Meta and Google Ads

• Support paid social, paid search, audience targeting, and testing strategies

• Recommend changes to improve performance across creative, targeting, and budget allocation

• Monitor pacing, delivery, and overall campaign health

• Assist with media planning, budget allocation, and performance forecasting

Analysis & Reporting

• Identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities across channels

• Translate complex data into clear, executive-ready recommendations

• Build reports, dashboards, and performance summaries for internal and client audiences

• Support campaign QA and ongoing performance monitoring

Collaboration

• Partner with media leadership on client priorities and strategic initiatives

• Support presentation development and planning efforts

• Collaborate cross-functionally with strategy, creative, analytics, and production teams

• Contribute to process improvements and operational efficiencies within the media function

What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of paid media / performance marketing experience

• Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads

• Strong analytical and reporting skills

• Experience with GA4, Google Sheets, Excel, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar tools

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Strong communication and presentation skills

• Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams

Nice to Have

• Agency experience

• Experience across additional channels including TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, or Trade Desk

• Experience with dashboard automation tools such as Supermetrics

• Familiarity with creative testing and messaging strategy

• Experience supporting integrated digital campaigns across multiple client verticals

Why Current

At Current , we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, well-crafted, and built to drive real impact.
We’re a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across a wide range of digital engagements including websites, platforms, campaigns, and product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex problems alongside smart, supportive teammates.
You’ll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and disciplines, contribute to meaningful work, and grow alongside a team that values curiosity, accountability, and strong operational thinking.

Senior Software Engineer, Tax Engineering
Tax Engineering sits at the intersection of every trade, every payment, and every product Coinbase ships. When a user buys Bitcoin, sells an equity, earns staking rewards, or redeems an Advisor-managed strategy, Tax Engineering is in the critical path, calculating cost basis, tracking gain/loss, determining withholding obligations, and producing compliance reporting across every product line and legal entity globally. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Tax team within the Consumer & Business group, you'll build the extensible primitives that make each new Coinbase launch possible, where scale and accuracy are both non-negotiable.

• Own the design and delivery of backend systems for cost basis tracking, gain/loss calculation, withholding automation, and tax reporting infrastructure

• Build new pipelines for broker reporting, automated withholding, and clearing integrations with partners as Coinbase expands into equities, margin, and options

• Partner with Product, Design, Tax, Trading, and Positions teams to take ambiguous problems from scoping through production rollout

• Drive an extensible tax architecture so every new product launch can plug into shared primitives without bespoke rework

• Strengthen engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, and technical mentorship across the team

Required Skills and Experience:

• 6+ years of backend software engineering experience building and operating production systems with high-quality, well-tested code

• Strong distributed systems fundamentals, with experience designing high-throughput services and data pipelines where correctness is critical

• Track record owning complex systems end-to-end, from design through production operation, in fast-changing domains

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional partners to translate ambiguous requirements into shipped solutions

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

title: City Scout - NY | SF | LA
description:
About Atlys
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
Atlys is changing that.
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries . But we’re still early.
The Role
We're looking for a City Scout to help build the most reliable database of work-friendly cafes for travellers across the USA.
You'll visit cafes across your assigned city, verify information like WiFi quality, internet speed, plug points and overall work-friendliness, and submit accurate data that powers a new Atlys product. Every visit directly improves the travel experience for thousands of users.
Hiring in: New York, San Francisco, and Los Angeles.
The Job

• Explore and discover great cafes: Visit assigned cafes across your city, experience them as a customer, and identify places that travellers would genuinely enjoy working from.

• Collect high-quality on-ground data: Verify key details including WiFi availability, internet speed, passwords, plug points, seating, ambience and overall work-friendliness to ensure the information is accurate and reliable.

• Contribute to a travel product used by thousands: Capture your observations by completing a short digital survey after every visit, helping build one of the world's most reliable databases of work-friendly cafes.

• Cover your city efficiently: Plan your visits across assigned neighbourhood clusters to maximize coverage while maintaining consistency and quality.

• Maintain exceptional data quality: Pay close attention to detail, validate every submission, and ensure the information travellers see on the Atlys app can be trusted.

The Ideal Candidate
You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

• Are a college student or have a flexible part-time schedule.

• Enjoy exploring your city and discovering new places.

• Have strong attention to detail and collect information accurately.

• Are comfortable travelling independently within your city.

• Own a smartphone and are reliable, proactive and self-driven.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.
Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

title: Senior Scientist, Synthetic Data Generation
description:
NVIDIA is at the forefront of the AI revolution, and our research is shaping the future of large language models. We are looking for a Senior Scientist to join our team and help advance our capabilities in synthetic data generation for training frontier models. You will contribute to open-source libraries within the NVIDIA NeMo ecosystem that generate synthetic datasets across text, code, structured, and multimodal data, directly feeding the pre- and post-training of LLMs such as Nemotron. This role combines hands-on software engineering with applied research in generative methods, and you will collaborate with research, engineering, product, and model teams as well as external labs.
What you'll be doing:

• Build synthetic data generation pipelines using LLM-based methods and automated quality evaluation, producing datasets that improve the pre- and post-training of LLMs such as Nemotron - reasoning, coding, structured output, and multimodal understanding.

• Advance multimodal synthetic data generation - image, document, video, and audio - in partnership with NVIDIA 's model teams.

• Design and maintain open-source libraries and SDKs with clean APIs and strong documentation.

• Drive software excellence with modern tooling, architecture based on configuration, and professional Git/CI-CD.

• Publish original research at top machine learning and AI conferences to maintain NVIDIA 's technical leadership.

• Mentor interns and junior researchers to develop technical growth within the team.

What we need to see:

• PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• A research background of 3+ years in synthetic data generation, generative modeling, multimodal machine learning, or related areas. Comparable experience is also considered.

• Deep technical understanding of LLMs, how data shapes their pre- and post-training, and inference frameworks such as vLLM or TGI.

• Proven track record of developing or maintaining software libraries used by a broad developer community.

• Strong publication record at premier venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL or similar.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Open-source contributions in ML or data tooling.

• Experience with multimodal generation or understanding (vision-language, document AI, video, or audio).

• Building and optimizing scalable data pipelines for large-scale model training (throughput, distributed inference).

• Experience generating data for agentic, tool-use, or reinforcement-learning post-training.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and talented people in the world working with us. If you are creative, autonomous, and passionate about building open-source tools that make AI safer and more private, we want to hear from you.
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 264,500 USD for Level 3, and 192,000 USD - 304,750 USD for Level 4. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 10, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Compute (Temporal Cloud)
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Temporal powers durable execution for the world’s most demanding AI and enterprise systems. The Compute team at Temporal makes that durability feel effortless by building the managed compute primitives that run workers and other execution systems across Temporal Cloud.

We’re solving a hard platform problem: make compute transparent, elastic, safe-by-default, observable, and multi-cloud - without turning customers into infrastructure operators. We build platform primitives that span a variety of execution environments (e.g., serverless-style runtimes, containerized fleets, and customer-controlled deployments). Our work sits at the intersection of control plane + data plane: scaling decisions, isolation boundaries, multi-tenant safety, and production-grade observability. If you’ve built autoscaling systems, multi-tenant platforms, or cloud infrastructure, you’ll find a lot to love here.

See the "Compute team" link to read more --> Compute team https://temporalio.notion.site/Join-Temporal-s-Compute-Team-598b6bca8bf84d3babf3e8e2a22c283c

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Invent

- Create new managed compute primitives that feel first-class in Temporal Cloud: crisp abstractions, clean APIs, and an extension story across compute providers.

- Design self-optimizing autoscaling systems (signals, backstops, debouncing, guardrails) that scale worker fleets safely and predictably.

- Define the Open Source Server ↔ Cloud boundary for compute capabilities, keeping the architecture cohesive and maintainable.

Own

- Architect, build, and operate services on the hot path of task execution where performance and correctness are customer-visible.

- Deliver real-world cloud integrations (e.g., customer-account execution): IAM boundaries, secure credentials handling, networking constraints, quotas, and failure modes.

- Make operability a feature: SLOs, tracing/metrics, load and failure testing, incident reviews, and continuous hardening.

- Ship end-to-end: API design, rollout strategy, backwards compatibility, and long-term maintenance.

Teach

- Raise the bar through design docs, strong reviews, pragmatic technical leadership, and mentorship.

- Lead through influence across teams (Server, SDKs, Security, Control Plane) to land coherent platform changes.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Significant experience building distributed systems or multi-tenant platform services (design, implementation, and production operations).

- Strong systems fundamentals: concurrency, performance, reliability, and failure-mode thinking.

- A record of shipping platform primitives used by other engineers/customers (APIs, control planes, data planes).

- Comfort owning outcomes: SLOs, incident response, and improving on-call quality over time.

- Excellent written communication and crisp tradeoff thinking. (Go experience is a plus; judgment matters most.)

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience building cloud infrastructure compute platforms.

- Experience with IAM/security boundaries for cross-account execution models.

- Having built Kubernetes controllers / CRDs or heterogeneous worker fleet operations.

title: Third-Party Risk Lead
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Legora builds AI software for legal work. Our products and operations depend on cloud platforms, AI model providers, software vendors, and other service partners. We need to understand which dependencies could disrupt our service or put information at risk, and act on that understanding.

You will lead our third-party risk program within Security. You will set assessment standards, lead complex reviews, and make sure significant findings reach a decision and an accountable owner. The role combines program leadership with hands-on assessment work.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Assess suppliers in context. Understand the service being purchased, the information it will handle, the access it needs, and the consequences of failure. Set the depth of each review accordingly. Examine supplier evidence and investigate gaps with the relevant technical teams.

- Understand our critical dependencies. Maintain a view of critical providers, their key subcontractors, and dependencies shared across services. Identify where we depend heavily on one provider or would struggle to replace it.

- Turn findings into action. Recommend approval conditions and practical mitigations, including changes to access, data sharing, or how a service is used. Agree owners and deadlines, track completion, and escalate unresolved risks for an authorized decision.

- Prepare for supplier failure. Work with Engineering and service owners on contingency, recovery, and exit plans for critical providers. Check whether those plans have been tested and make remaining gaps visible.

- Manage risk throughout the relationship. Build reviews into onboarding, material service changes, renewals, and offboarding. Define when reassessment is needed and coordinate follow-up after supplier incidents. Keep subprocessor information accurate and work with Legal on customer notification commitments.

- Improve how assessments run. Set clear review standards and check assessment quality. Use automation and AI where they improve evidence collection or follow-up, with traceable sources and checks on their output.

- Give leadership a useful view of risk. Report assessment coverage, unresolved material findings, overdue actions, and the readiness of critical suppliers’ contingency plans. Explain the decisions needed and the consequences of delaying them.

You own the risk assessment and oversight process. Business owners remain responsible for their supplier relationships and authorized risk acceptance. You will work with Engineering on technical changes and with Procurement and Legal on commercial and contractual requirements.

title: Senior SAP S/4HANA Developer

description:
About us:

 

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.

The Role:

 

We are looking for a Senior SAP S/4HANA Developer on behalf of our client to lead backend and full-stack development within a modern S/4HANA enterprise landscape. In this role, you will take technical ownership of designing, building, and extending mission-critical SAP applications-leveraging modern development paradigms such as the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) and Core Data Services (CDS).

You will drive modern, upgrade-stable SAP development by adhering strictly to "Clean Core" architectural guidelines. Rather than relying on legacy, modification-heavy ABAP patterns, you will build side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP, expose optimized OData services, push heavy calculations down to the in-memory SAP HANA database, and deliver intuitive user experiences via SAP Fiori.

 

What we’re looking for:

 

•
5+ years of SAP development experience, with at least 3 years dedicated to S/4HANA, featuring expert command of Object-Oriented ABAP (OO-ABAP), New ABAP Syntax (7.4+), and RAP (ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model).

•
Advanced proficiency authoring complex Core Data Services (CDS) Views, parameters, associations, access controls (DCL), and ABAP Managed Database Procedures (AMDP) for code push-down performance.

•
Extensive experience creating and exposing OData v2/v4 services via SAP Gateway (SEGW) or RAP business services for UI consumption and third-party cloud integrations.

•
Practical experience developing custom SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications or configuring Fiori Elements apps using CDS annotations.

•
Firm understanding of modern SAP extensibility frameworks, including On-Stack Developer Extensibility (Embedded ABAP / Steampunk) and Side-by-Side Extensibility using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

•
Proven ability to trace, profile, and optimize ABAP/HANA execution using Runtime Analysis (SAT), ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC), SQL Trace (ST05), and SQL Monitor (SQLM).

 

Nice-to-have skills:

 

•
Hands-on experience developing side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP using Node.js/CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) or ABAP Cloud.

•
Background in legacy-to-S/4HANA code remediation, custom code analysis (CCA), and migration projects.

•
Exposure to Event-Driven Architecture using SAP Event Mesh or Kafka integrations.

•
Knowledge of standard SAP S/4HANA business process modules (FI/CO, SD, MM, or PP).

 

Responsibilities:

 

•
Architect, build, and maintain high-performing transactional and analytical SAP applications using ABAP RAP, CDS views, and AMDP.

•
Build upgrade-stable enhancements and side-by-side extensions, strictly minimizing legacy modifications to protect core system stability.

•
Design and expose secure OData endpoints to power SAP Fiori user interfaces, mobile apps, and enterprise cloud integrations.

•
Perform automated code checks (ATC), enforce clean code standards, conduct peer code reviews, and optimize legacy custom code for S/4HANA compatibility.

•
Collaborate closely with SAP functional consultants, enterprise architects, and BTP specialists to translate business requirements into technical solution specifications.

 

 

What we offer:

 

Get paid, not played

No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments

At Nymbus , we’re revolutionizing banking technology. Our award-winning modern core platform and cloud-based solutions help financial institutions modernize, scale, and succeed. As part of our team, you won’t just be part of a tech revolution; you’ll be at the forefront of it, driving innovation and delivering exceptional client experiences.
Nymbus is building the next generation of fintech platforms, and that takes people who are ready to challenge convention, move with purpose, and reimagine what’s possible. Banks and credit unions are rebuilding what members and customers expect from service, and Nymbus is rebuilding how we deliver it. This role sits at the center of that shift.
We are seeking a Vice President, Digital Experience & AI Service Operations to define and lead the multi-year strategy for how Nymbus supports its financial institution clients and their end users. You have led managers, owned a meaningful budget, and balanced service quality, cost to serve, and growth without treating any of the three as optional. You are a compassionate leader with a deep passion for developing talent, and you create an environment where strong performers thrive and everyone has a clear path to grow.
You think in systems and see the whole board. You are energized by ambiguity and by building what doesn't exist yet. The Executive Vice President, Sales Strategy and Growth is responsible for leading CTM North America's commercial growth strategy and driving sustainable revenue expansion across enterprise markets. As a key member of the executive leadership team, this position develops and executes forward-thinking sales strategies that align with evolving customer expectations, industry trends, and business objectives.
This role serves as a strategic commercial leader focused on revenue growth, market share expansion, enterprise client acquisition, and executive-level relationship management. The EVP will champion a modern go-to-market approach by leveraging market intelligence, consultative selling methodologies, and data-driven sales practices to position CTM as a strategic partner for managed travel solutions.
The EVP, Sales Strategy and Growth is responsible for building and developing high-performing sales teams, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and ensuring the organization remains competitive within the rapidly evolving corporate travel industry.

Responsibilities and Duties

• Develop and execute short- and long-term sales strategies aligned with CTM's growth objectives, revenue targets, and overall business strategy.

• Ensure sales teams effectively leverage data, analytics, market intelligence, and customer insights throughout the sales cycle.

• Develop and maintain executive relationships with C-suite leaders, procurement stakeholders, travel managers, and other key decision-makers within target and existing client organizations.

• Position CTM as a trusted strategic advisor through industry expertise, thought leadership, and consultative client engagement.

title: Deal Operations, AMER
description:
About the Role

OpenAI is seeking a senior individual contributor to support revenue growth across the Americas (AMER) by helping sales teams structure and close commercially sound deals. You will balance speed and responsiveness with pricing discipline, consistent processes, and appropriate financial and commercial controls.

In this role, you will be the day-to-day Deal Operations partner for AMER account teams, reviewing pricing, discounts, and commercial terms across new business, renewals, and expansions. You will guide sellers through deal requirements, evaluate non-standard requests, and coordinate the approvals needed to move opportunities through contracting and closure.

You will also develop scalable workflows, guidance, and tools that improve deal turnaround times, documentation quality, and consistency across the region.

This role partners closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Pricing, and Revenue Operations, with Product and other teams engaged as needed, to resolve deal issues and support accurate execution from quote through contract and booking.

In this role, you will:

- Serve as the primary Deal Operations contact for AMER account teams, managing deal intake, prioritizing requests, and guiding sellers through pricing, review, and approval processes.

- Review quotes and proposed commercial terms, including discounts, payment schedules, contract duration, and customer commitments, for accuracy and alignment with pricing guidelines and commercial policies.

- Build financial analyses and deal models to assess revenue, margin, discount impact, and profitability, and explain the tradeoffs of proposed deal structures to decision-makers.

- Maintain complete deal records and approval documentation in CRM, CPQ, and contract management systems, and partner with Revenue Operations to align approved terms, executed agreements, and booking information.

- Help develop and maintain deal approval policies, escalation paths, pricing guidance, and standardized templates. Improve workflows to reduce bottlenecks while maintaining appropriate controls.

- Equip sellers with practical guidance and training on deal requirements and approval processes. Apply AI and automation to improve deal intake, knowledge retrieval, and self-service support.

- Track Deal Desk metrics such as turnaround time, approval bottlenecks, exception trends, and quote accuracy. Use recurring deal patterns to recommend improvements to commercial policies, processes, and tools.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have:

- 8+ years of experience in Deal Desk, commercial finance, pricing, sales operations, or a related function, preferably in a high-growth technology environment.

- Hands-on experience reviewing and structuring complex enterprise deals and supporting quoting, commercial approvals, and contracting processes.

- Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, including experience assessing pricing, discounts, revenue, margins, and deal profitability.

- Knowledge of enterprise software commercial terms and subscription or consumption-based business models, with the judgment to identify issues that require Legal or Finance review.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain commercial tradeoffs, make clear recommendations, and coordinate timely decisions across teams.

- Experience with CRM systems, configure-price-quote (CPQ) tools, and contract

title: Business Operations Manager
description:
This is a remote position.

Business Operations Manager Remote (India) | Full-time
Also searched as: Operations Manager, Business Operations Lead, PMO Manager, Project Operations Manager, Shared Services Manager, GCC Operations Manager. Could you lead ops coordinators, project managers and service teams while carrying real projects alongside them? On a typical day you might run the planning call for a cross-team project you are leading, review a dashboard showing which requests are running late, sit with a pod lead to rebuild an estimate that looks twice as long as the last similar job, and agree with the Internal Product team which manual handoff to automate next.
About Contour

We operate across three brands. The India team, part of the Global Enablement and Support pillar, is the global capability centre (GCC) Contour is building. It runs delivery, automation, people and operations for the whole organisation, working closely with teams in Australia.

The kind of people who thrive here Contour started in 2020 as one classroom in a university library. In 2022 three full-time team members ran the business on. Today we are about 600 people across Australia and India, and much of what we run was built by someone who noticed it was missing. The work matters. More than 10,000 students rely on what we build, from the booklets they study from to the systems their families pay through. People who do well here care about that. They own their work end to end, start things without being asked and finish what they commit to. They tell the truth early, write decisions down and give direct feedback. The pace is fast: small problems are fixed the same week, bigger ones within the six-week cycle. Growth follows what you deliver: scope, title and pay move with the bar you raise. About this role You lead Operations in Contour's India team: several teams brought together under one player-coach. Your team includes Contour’s operations coordinators, who keep academics, campus, finance and the founder’s office running day to day, and its project coordinators and managers, who run cross-team work across the business. It also covers organisation services such as print operations, procurement and workspace systems. Each service has two sides. In Australia, a functional owner, such as Finance or Academics, sets its standards and priorities. In India, you run the work: coordinators and project managers report to you directly, and any service big enough for its own pod lead reports through them. Everything else is yours: how work comes in, how it is planned, checked and automated, and how the people doing it grow. Two things separate a strong hire here from a competent one. First, you learn each service's workflow well enough to coach its lead, inspect what it produces and challenge its estimates, and you know where your knowledge stops: on professional questions, you rely on the specialists. Second, you make different services run as one, with a shared way of taking requests, planning capacity and checking work, so the rest of Contour deals with one group rather than a row of separate desks. This is a player-coach seat, and we mean it. Expect a real share of most weeks to go on doing the work yourself: running a cross-team project end to end, taking the coordination nobody else can untangle, checking a sample of finished work, mapping a process that keeps stalling or rebuilding an estimate from the ground up. The rest goes on making your coordinators, project managers and pod leads better at the same work. You won't be the specialist in every service, but you can work inside each one's workflow, and your team sees you do it. Contour is scaling and hires for the long term: the scope of this seat grows with the platform, and what you deliver decides how fast. The intake, planning, quality and automation routines you set now are what every later service joins. What you will do

•
Run work yourself: lead some cross-team projects and coordination directly,

title: Satellite Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
COMPANY

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Role Overview

You will design satellite structure and hardware, and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised and under control as the design matures. Working within a small, multidisciplinary team, you will translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing.

 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, including secondary structures (panels, brackets and component mounts), thermal-control hardware, cable and harness routing, and mechanisms. Primary structure experience is welcome.

- Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, using top-down design and skeleton models to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model.

- Manage assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released.

- Run interference and clash checks and maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts.

- Produce fully dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings and interface control documents using GD&T.

- Support design reviews (PDR and CDR) and qualification, working with structural and thermal engineers on analysis and verification planning.

- Optimise designs for manufacturability, cost, mass and reliability, working directly with manufacturers and suppliers.

- Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results.

- Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform.

 

Required Skills & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline.

- 3+ years' experience in mechanical design of aerospace, space or other high-reliability hardware, with strong 3D CAD skills (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered).

- Practical application of GD&T and experience producing manufacturing-ready drawings.

- Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics.

- Demonstrated ability to design, build and test hardware, including troubleshooting and iteration.

- Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team.

Preferred Experience

- Satellite or spacecraft design, ideally detailed design of secondary structures (panel and component mounting, thermal hardware, cable and harness routing). Primary structure experience is a plus.

- Experience working in large, multi-person CAD assemblies, including top-down design, skeleton or master models, in-context references and configurations.

- Experience with PLM or PDM systems (for example 3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX'), Windchill, Teamcenter, ENOVIA or SolidWorks PDM), configuration management, revision control and formal change processes (ECO/ECR/ECN).

- Experience working within formal engineering processes, such as design reviews, documented requirements and standards.

- Hardware that has launched.

- Basic FEA familiarity, MGSE or ground-support equi

Our businesses - Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios - maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem - connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport - delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

 

About the Company

Fanatics Collect is a global product and technology group dedicated to transforming the collectibles experience. Through industry-leading marketplaces, vault storage, authentication, and live commerce platforms, we support collectors worldwide while operating in highly secure, climate-controlled environments designed to protect high-value assets.

 

Role Purpose

As the Senior Facilities Manager for the Fanatics Collect Oregon Vault, you will provide senior-level ownership of facility operations, environmental integrity, safety, and security for a highly specialized, high-value storage and operations site. This role requires deep operational expertise, strong institutional knowledge, and the ability to independently manage risk in a fast-moving, high-impact environment.

You will ensure the Vault operates at peak reliability while supporting growth, operational efficiency, and customer trust through best-in-class facility standards.

 

Key Responsibilities

Facility & Infrastructure Leadership

• Own end-to-end facilities operations for the Oregon Vault, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, life-safety systems, security infrastructure, janitorial, grounds, and general upkeep.

• Serve as the primary point of accountability and escalation for all facility-related incidents impacting Vault operations.

• Maintain strict environmental controls (temperature, humidity, air quality) to protect high-value collectibles and ensure compliance with Vault standards.

Capital Projects & Continuous Improvement

• Lead planning and execution of small- to mid-scale capital and operational projects such as climate system upgrades, racking installations, workflow reconfigurations, and security/access-control enhancements.

• Apply historical knowledge of site infrastructure and prior build decisions to guide upgrades and prevent rework.

• Identify and implement preventive maintenance programs and reliability improvements to reduce downtime and emergency spend.

Financial & Vendor Management

• Own operational and capital facilities budgets, including forecasting, spend tracking, and financial reporting.

• Manage vendor relationships across maintenance, janitorial, landscaping, building systems, and specialty contractors.

• Evaluate vendor performance, negotiate service agreements, and ensure contract compliance.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Act as the central facilities liaison across Vault Operations, Inventory & Authentication, IT, Security, Procurement, and Corporate Real Estate.

• Influence and drive alignment across teams without direct authority to ensure facility readiness supports business priorities.

description:

Bist du aktiv auf der Suche nach einer neuen Herausforderung? Oder schaust du dich einfach nur auf dem Markt um? Nun… dann bist du hier vielleicht genau richtig!

Wir suchen eine/n Head of Field Sales für unser Hospitality-Team vor Ort in München. In dieser Rolle übernehmst du eine Schlüsselfunktion: Du wirst ein komplett neues Team von ca. 8 bis 10 Outbound Field Account Executives aufbauen, strukturieren und leiten.

- Teamaufbau & -leitung: Du rekrutierst, führst und coachst ein neues Field-basiertes Team, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Fähigkeiten und die Einhaltung von Best Practices zu fördern.

WAS SONST NOCH DAZUGEHÖRT...

Als Teil des erweiterten Teams trägst du maßgeblich zu unseren übergeordneten Unternehmenszielen bei. Das bedeutet auch, dass du mal dort anpackst, wo es brennt - selbst wenn es nicht strikt in deinen Aufgabenbereich fällt (echter Teamgeist eben!).

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

title: Full-Stack Developer - Next.js & Python
description:
Full-Stack Developer - Next.js & Python
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer to build and maintain production web applications across a modern frontend, backend, database, and cloud stack.
This is a hands-on development role for someone who can own a slice of the product across both UI and API. You’ll work with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, relational and graph databases, multi-service architecture, real-time functionality, and Azure infrastructure.
What You’ll Own
Frontend Development

• Build production web applications using Next.js 16 with App Router, React 19, and strict TypeScript.

• Work with server/client boundaries and data-fetching using TanStack Query or equivalent.

• Build interfaces using Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui + Radix, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, and AG Grid Enterprise.

• Work with Framer Motion and Socket.IO.

• Write frontend tests using Vitest + Testing Library.

• Build end-to-end tests using Playwright.

Backend Development

• Build and maintain backend services using Python 3.13 and FastAPI.

• Work with Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy 2 / SQLModel, Alembic, Celery, Redis, and uv.

• Work with typed schemas, async I/O, authentication, and background jobs.

• Work within a multi-service codebase using HTTP between services, Redis, and workers.

Database & Data

• Work with relational modeling and migrations using SQLAlchemy/Alembic or equivalent.

• Work with Azure SQL (MSSQL) and PostgreSQL.

• Work with Neo4j for family / heirship graphs.

• Work with PostgreSQL + pgvector.

• Work with MongoDB for logs.

Cloud & Operations

• Work with Azure services including Blob, Identity, Key Vault, SQL, and Container Registry.

• Work with Docker Compose.

• Work with Prometheus / Grafana.

• Work with pnpm workspaces + Turborepo.

Advanced Features & Integrations

• Work with graph databases or non-trivial graph UIs such as trees, canvases, XYFlow/D3/canvas.

• Work with complex data UIs including AG Grid, maps, PDF viewers, and rich text using Tiptap.

• Work with real-time technologies such as Socket.IO / WebRTC or telephony platforms such as Telnyx or similar.

• Work with LLM/RAG features including embeddings, pgvector, and tool-using assistants.

• Work with chatbot services; you do not need to be an ML engineer.

Required Experience & Skills

• 6+ years shipping production web apps.

• 3+ years as the person who owns a slice across UI and API.

• Strong TypeScript and React experience.

• Comfortable with App Router, server/client boundaries, and data-fetching using TanStack Query or equivalent.

• Strong Python and FastAPI experience, or Django/Flask at a similar depth.

• Experience with typed schemas, async I/O, authentication, and background jobs.

• Strong relational modeling and migration experience using SQLAlchemy/Alembic or equivalent.

• Experience with MSSQL or PostgreSQL.

• Experience in a multi-service codebase with HTTP between services, Redis, and workers, not only a single monolith.

• Tests as a habit: unit/integration on the backend and component tests on the frontend.

• Clear written communication.

• Ability to leave the next engineer a module they can change without a walkthrough.

Strongly Preferred

• Graph databases such as Neo4j or non-trivial graph UI using trees, canvases, XYFlow/D3/canvas.

• Azure experience with SQL, Blob, Key Vault, or a comparable cloud.

• Experience with complex data UIs such as AG Grid, maps, PDF viewers, or rich text using Tiptap.

• Real-time experience with Socket.IO / WebRTC or telephony with Telnyx or similar.

• LLM/RAG experience including embeddings, pgvector, and tool-using assistants.

Nice-to-Haves We Actually Use
